source.profile: Numerical input arrays exported from the pinned checkout; external source code itself is linked and not bundled.

scope.grid: The 256 LP2-49–51 printed tokens in their 32×8 row order, converted with the declared base-60 digit alphabet; reverse order is the only alternate byte route.
scope.byte_grid: 12 specified finite/repeated key streams × xor/subtract/add mod256 × forward/reversed grid =72 rows. At least90% printable bytes or one of the exact source offset-zero signatures passes.
scope.rune_grid: Grid bytes mod29 and individual base-60 digits mod29, each forward/reversed; three GP29 directions, 29 constant shifts or three specified rune keys =384 rows. Pass at drift-tolerant source log LR≥30.
scope.source_controls: Stage N itself did not have a planted detector-control gate. Checker-supplied synthetic positive cases are explicitly post-replay diagnostics, not prospective evidence about power for LP2.
